input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for r r exception handler, abstract, service. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include social functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to interact with index functionality, so that I can accomplish my index-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to use r r exception handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use abstract capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use service capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
